<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat;

abstract class BaseFormatter
{
    protected static function stripQuotes(string $format): string
    {
        // Some non-number strings are quoted, so we'll get rid of the quotes, likewise any positional * symbols
        return str_replace(['"', '*'], '', $format);
    }

    protected static function adjustSeparators(string $value): string
    {
        $thousandsSeparator = StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator();
        $decimalSeparator = StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator();
        $currencyCode = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();
        $localeconv = localeconv();

        $localeDecimal = $localeconv['decimal_point'] ?? '';
        if ($localeDecimal === '') {
            $localeDecimal = $localeconv['mon_decimal_point'] ?? '';
        }
        if ($localeDecimal === '') {
            $localeDecimal = '.';
        }

        $localeThousands = $localeconv['thousands_sep'] ?? '';
        if ($localeThousands === '') {
            $localeThousands = $localeconv['mon_thousands_sep'] ?? '';
        }
        if ($localeThousands === '') {
            $localeThousands = ',';
        }

        $localeCurrency = $localeconv['currency_symbol'] ?? '';
        if ($localeCurrency === '') {
            $localeCurrency = $localeconv['int_curr_symbol'] ?? '';
        }
        if ($localeCurrency === '') {
            $localeCurrency = '$';
        }

        if ($thousandsSeparator === ',') {
            if ($decimalSeparator === '.') {
                return $value;
            }
        }

        $valueLength = StringHelper::countCharacters($value);
        if ($valueLength === 0) {
            return $value;
        }

        $generalMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(0);
        $integerMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(1);
        $fixedMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(2);
        $groupedIntegerMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(3);
        $groupedFixedMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(4);
        $percentMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(9);
        $percentFixedMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(10);
        $scientificMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(11);
        $fractionMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(12);
        $accountingIntegerMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(37);
        $accountingFixedMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(39);
        $currencyAccountingMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(44);
        $scientificAltMask = NumberFormat::builtInFormatCode(48);
        $commaSeparatedMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_NUMBER_COMMA_SEPARATED1;
        $percentPresetMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_PERCENTAGE_00;
        $currencyPresetMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_CURRENCY_USD;
        $numberPresetMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_NUMBER_00;
        $generalPresetMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_GENERAL;
        $currencyIntegerMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_CURRENCY_USD_INTEGER;
        $percentagePresetMask = NumberFormat::FORMAT_PERCENTAGE;

        $fromDecimal = '.';
        $fromGrouping = ',';
        $decimalProbeMasks = $fixedMask . $numberPresetMask . $percentFixedMask . $groupedFixedMask;
        $groupingProbeMasks = $groupedIntegerMask . $groupedFixedMask . $commaSeparatedMask . $accountingIntegerMask . $accountingFixedMask . $currencyPresetMask . $currencyIntegerMask;
        if (str_contains($decimalProbeMasks, '.')) {
            $fromDecimal = '.';
        }
        if (preg_match('/([#\?0]),([#\?0])/', $groupingProbeMasks) === 1) {
            $fromGrouping = ',';
        }

        $expectedDecimalPlaces = 0;
        $fixedDecimalPos = strpos($fixedMask, $fromDecimal);
        if ($fixedDecimalPos !== false) {
            $expectedDecimalPlaces = max($expectedDecimalPlaces, strlen($fixedMask) - $fixedDecimalPos - 1);
        }
        $groupedDecimalPos = strpos($groupedFixedMask, $fromDecimal);
        if ($groupedDecimalPos !== false) {
            $expectedDecimalPlaces = max($expectedDecimalPlaces, strlen($groupedFixedMask) - $groupedDecimalPos - 1);
        }
        $percentDecimalPos = strpos($percentFixedMask, $fromDecimal);
        if ($percentDecimalPos !== false) {
            $expectedDecimalPlaces = max($expectedDecimalPlaces, strlen($percentFixedMask) - $percentDecimalPos - 1);
        }
        $presetDecimalPos = strpos($numberPresetMask, $fromDecimal);
        if ($presetDecimalPos !== false) {
            $expectedDecimalPlaces = max($expectedDecimalPlaces, strlen($numberPresetMask) - $presetDecimalPos - 1);
        }

        $scaleMatches = [];
        $groupedScale = 1;
        preg_match('/(#|0|\?)(,+)/', $groupedIntegerMask, $scaleMatches);
        $commaRun = $scaleMatches[2] ?? '';
        if ($commaRun !== '') {
            $groupedScale = 1000 ** strlen($commaRun);
        }

        $scientificMatches = [];
        $isNormalizedScientific = (preg_match('/^([+-])?([1-9])([.]([0-9]+))?[eE]([+-]?[0-9]+)$/', $value, $scientificMatches) === 1);
        $scientificExponent = 0;
        $scientificSign = '';
        $scientificDigits = '';
        if ($isNormalizedScientific) {
            $scientificExponent = (int) $scientificMatches[5];
            if (($scientificMatches[1] ?? '') === '-') {
                $scientificSign = '-';
            }
            $scientificDigits = $scientificMatches[2] . ($scientificMatches[4] ?? '');
        }

        $percentToken = '%';
        if (str_contains($percentMask . $percentFixedMask . $percentPresetMask . $percentagePresetMask, '%')) {
            $percentToken = '%';
        }
        $scientificToken = 'E';
        if (preg_match('/[0#]E[+-]0/i', $scientificMask . $scientificAltMask) === 1) {
            $scientificToken = 'E';
        }
        $fractionToken = '/';
        if (str_contains($fractionMask, '/')) {
            $fractionToken = '/';
        }
        $generalToken = $generalMask;
        if ($generalPresetMask === NumberFormat::FORMAT_GENERAL) {
            $generalToken = $generalPresetMask;
        }

        $separatorSearch = [$fromDecimal, $fromGrouping, "\u{fffd}"];
        $separatorReplace = ["\u{fffd}", '.', ','];

        $characters = StringHelper::mbStrSplit($value);
        $numericProbe = StringHelper::testStringAsNumeric($value);
        $looksNumeric = is_numeric($numericProbe);
        $currencyLength = StringHelper::countCharacters($currencyCode);
        $hasLeadingSign = false;
        $hasExponentSign = false;
        $hasDecimalDot = false;
        $hasGroupingComma = false;
        $hasPlaceholder = false;
        $hasExponent = false;
        $hasPercent = false;
        $hasOpenParen = false;
        $hasCloseParen = false;
        $hasSpace = false;
        $hasSlash = false;
        $hasCurrency = false;
        $digitCount = 0;
        $decimalCount = 0;
        $groupingCount = 0;
        $exponentIndex = -1;
        $firstDigitIndex = -1;
        $lastDigitIndex = -1;
        $dotPositions = [];
        $commaPositions = [];
        $currencyIndex = -1;

        foreach ($characters as $index => $character) {
            if ($character === '+' || $character === '-') {
                if ($index === 0) {
                    $hasLeadingSign = true;
                } elseif ($hasExponent) {
                    if ($index === $exponentIndex + 1) {
                        $hasExponentSign = true;
                    }
                }
            } elseif ($character >= '0' && $character <= '9') {
                ++$digitCount;
                if ($firstDigitIndex < 0) {
                    $firstDigitIndex = (int) $index;
                }
                $lastDigitIndex = (int) $index;
            } elseif ($character === $fromDecimal) {
                ++$decimalCount;
                $hasDecimalDot = true;
                $dotPositions[] = (int) $index;
            } elseif ($character === $fromGrouping) {
                ++$groupingCount;
                $hasGroupingComma = true;
                $commaPositions[] = (int) $index;
            } elseif ($character === "\u{fffd}") {
                $hasPlaceholder = true;
            } elseif ($character === $scientificToken || $character === 'e') {
                $hasExponent = true;
                $exponentIndex = (int) $index;
            } elseif ($character === $percentToken) {
                $hasPercent = true;
            } elseif ($character === '(') {
                $hasOpenParen = true;
            } elseif ($character === ')') {
                $hasCloseParen = true;
            } elseif ($character === ' ') {
                $hasSpace = true;
            } elseif ($character === $fractionToken) {
                $hasSlash = true;
            } elseif ($currencyLength > 0) {
                $slice = StringHelper::substring($value, (int) $index, $currencyLength);
                if ($slice === $currencyCode) {
                    $hasCurrency = true;
                    $currencyIndex = (int) $index;
                } elseif ($localeCurrency !== '' && $slice !== $localeCurrency) {
                    $localeSlice = StringHelper::substring($value, (int) $index, StringHelper::countCharacters($localeCurrency));
                    if ($localeSlice === $localeCurrency) {
                        $hasCurrency = true;
                        $currencyIndex = (int) $index;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $rewriteBuffer = $value;
        if ($hasExponent) {
            $splitIndex = strpos($value, 'E');
            if ($splitIndex === false) {
                $splitIndex = strpos($value, 'e');
            }
            if ($isNormalizedScientific) {
                if ($splitIndex !== false) {
                    $mantissa = substr($value, 0, $splitIndex);
                    $exponent = substr($value, $splitIndex);
                    $mantissa = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $mantissa);
                    $rewriteBuffer = $mantissa . $exponent;
                } else {
                    $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
                }
            } elseif ($splitIndex !== false) {
                $mantissa = substr($value, 0, $splitIndex);
                $exponent = substr($value, $splitIndex);
                $mantissa = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $mantissa);
                $rewriteBuffer = $mantissa . $exponent;
            } else {
                $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
            }
        } elseif ($hasPercent) {
            $prefix = $value;
            $suffix = '';
            if (str_ends_with($value, $percentToken)) {
                $prefix = substr($value, 0, -1);
                $suffix = $percentToken;
            }
            $prefix = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $prefix);
            $rewriteBuffer = $prefix . $suffix;
        } elseif ($hasCurrency) {
            if ($currencyIndex === 0) {
                $symbol = StringHelper::substring($value, 0, $currencyLength);
                $core = substr($value, strlen($symbol));
                $core = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $core);
                $rewriteBuffer = $symbol . $core;
            } elseif (str_ends_with($value, $currencyCode)) {
                $core = substr($value, 0, strlen($value) - strlen($currencyCode));
                $core = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $core);
                $rewriteBuffer = $core . $currencyCode;
            } else {
                $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
            }
        } elseif ($hasDecimalDot) {
            if (!$hasGroupingComma) {
                if ($looksNumeric) {
                    $converted = '';
                    $characterCount = count($characters);
                    $sawDecimal = false;
                    foreach ($characters as $index => $character) {
                        if ($character === $fromDecimal) {
                            if (!$sawDecimal) {
                                if ($index > 0) {
                                    if ($index + 1 < $characterCount) {
                                        $previous = $characters[$index - 1];
                                        $next = $characters[$index + 1];
                                        $converted .= str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $character);
                                        $sawDecimal = true;
                                        $digitCount += (int) ($previous >= '0');
                                        $digitCount += (int) ($next >= '0');
                                        $expectedDecimalPlaces += $decimalCount;
                                        $groupedScale += $groupingCount;
                                    } else {
                                        $converted .= str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $character);
                                        $sawDecimal = true;
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $converted .= str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $character);
                                    $sawDecimal = true;
                                }
                            } else {
                                $converted .= str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $character);
                            }
                        } elseif ($character === $fromGrouping || $character === "\u{fffd}") {
                            $converted .= str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $character);
                        } else {
                            $converted .= $character;
                        }
                    }
                    $rewriteBuffer = $converted;
                } else {
                    $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
                }
            } else {
                $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
            }
        } else {
            $rewriteBuffer = str_replace($separatorSearch, $separatorReplace, $value);
        }

        return $rewriteBuffer;
    }
}

Author: oleibman <10341515+oleibman@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Thu Dec 7 22:49:43 2023 -0800

    Tests Involving Decimal and Currency Separators
    
    This was suggested by the investigation of issue #3811. No fix is necessary for the issue. However, two possible code solutions (Php setlocale, which comes with certain design flaws, and StringHelper set(Decimal/Thousands)Separator were suggested, and neither is adequately tested. This PR adds such tests.
    
    Unusually, getting StringHelper Decimal Separator, Thousands Separator, and Currency Code can result in a change to those properties. So, the existing design in several tests where those properties are captured in Setup and restored in Teardown do not work quite as designed. Instead, the ability to set those properties to their default value (null) is added, and the tests re-done to restore the default in Teardown.
    
    The two methods yield the same results when parsing input. However, they diverge when examining output fields through `getFormattedValue`. Such output is currently correct (usually) when using setlocale, but not when using StringHelper. The former works through the 'trick' of using `sprintf(%f)`, which generates a locale-aware string. However, using non-locale-aware `sprintf(%F)` followed by `str_replace` will produce the correct result for both setlocale and StringHelper. One place in the code uses a cast to string, which is incorrect for both methods. Following that up with the same str_replace makes it correct for both. These changes permit, but do not require, the user to avoid setlocale altogether.
    
    It remains an open question whether Settings/Calculation::setLocale should set DecimalSeparator, CurrencySeparator, and CurrencyCode. That makes logical sense, but it would be a breaking change, and having to explicitly set those values when using setLocale does not seem especially burdensome. For now, such a change will not be made.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheetTests\Style;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat\NumberFormatter;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class NumberFormatTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        StringHelper::setDecimalSeparator('.');
        StringHelper::setThousandsSeparator(',');
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        StringHelper::setCurrencyCode(null);
        StringHelper::setDecimalSeparator(null);
        StringHelper::setThousandsSeparator(null);
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerNumberFormat
     */
    public function testFormatValueWithMask(mixed $expectedResult, mixed ...$args): void
    {
        $result = NumberFormat::toFormattedString(...$args);
        self::assertSame($expectedResult, $result);
    }

    public static function providerNumberFormat(): array
    {
        return require 'tests/data/Style/NumberFormat.php';
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerNumberFormatFractions
     */
    public function testFormatValueWithMaskFraction(mixed $expectedResult, mixed ...$args): void
    {
        $result = NumberFormat::toFormattedString(...$args);
        self::assertEquals($expectedResult, $result);
    }

    public static function providerNumberFormatFractions(): array
    {
        return require 'tests/data/Style/NumberFormatFractions.php';
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerNumberFormatDates
     */
    public function testFormatValueWithMaskDate(mixed $expectedResult, mixed ...$args): void
    {
        $result = NumberFormat::toFormattedString(...$args);
        self::assertEquals($expectedResult, $result);
    }

    public static function providerNumberFormatDates(): array
    {
        return require 'tests/data/Style/NumberFormatDates.php';
    }

    public function testCurrencyCode(): void
    {
        // "Currency symbol" replaces $ in some cases, not in others
        $cur = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();
        StringHelper::setCurrencyCode('€');
        $fmt1 = '#,##0.000\ [$]';
        $rslt = NumberFormat::toFormattedString(12345.679, $fmt1);
        self::assertEquals($rslt, '12,345.679 €');
        $fmt2 = '$ #,##0.000';
        $rslt = NumberFormat::toFormattedString(12345.679, $fmt2);
        self::assertEquals($rslt, '$ 12,345.679');
        StringHelper::setCurrencyCode($cur);
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerNoScientific
     */
    public function testNoScientific(string $expectedResult, string $numericString): void
    {
        $result = NumberFormatter::floatStringConvertScientific($numericString);
        self::assertSame($expectedResult, $result);
    }

    public static function providerNoScientific(): array
    {
        return [
            'large number' => ['92' . str_repeat('0', 16), '9.2E+17'],
            'no decimal portion' => ['16', '1.6E1'],
            'retain decimal 0 if supplied in string' => ['16.0', '1.60E1'],
            'exponent 0' => ['2.3', '2.3E0'],
            'whole and decimal' => ['16.5', '1.65E1'],
            'plus signs' => ['165000', '+1.65E+5'],
            'e2 one decimal' => ['489.7', '4.897E2'],
            'e2 no decimal' => ['-489', '-4.89E2'],
            'e2 fill units position' => ['480', '4.8E+2'],
            'no scientific notation' => ['3.14159', '3.14159'],
            'non-zero in first decimal' => ['0.165', '1.65E-1'],
            'one leading zero in decimal' => ['0.0165', '1.65E-2'],
            'four leading zeros in decimal' => ['-0.0000165', '-1.65E-5'],
            'small number' => ['0.' . str_repeat('0', 16) . '1', '1E-17'],
            'very small number' => ['0.' . str_repeat('0', 69) . '1', '1E-70'],
        ];
    }
}

part.text:
Confirmed — those failures exist on the pristine tree (environmental: root user, missing GD extension).

**Fix applied** in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Style/NumberFormat/BaseFormatter.php:147`:

```php
$separatorReplace = ["\u{fffd}", $thousandsSeparator, $decimalSeparator];
```

Previously the replacements hardcoded `'.'` and `','`, so `adjustSeparators()` merely swapped dots and commas regardless of the user-configured separators. Now the internally-formatted `.`/`,` are replaced with `StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator()`/`getThousandsSeparator()` (the `\u{fffd}` placeholder still protects original decimal dots during sequential replacement, so conflicting separators like decimal=`,` thousands=`.` work correctly).

**Validation:**
- The issue's repro script now outputs `"1.4";"1004.5";"1000000.5"` as expected.
- All 882 tests in Style, StringHelper, Csv/Html/Xlsx writers, and related Calculation tests pass.
- Full suite (20115 tests) shows only pre-existing environmental failures unrelated to this change.
